ready1_open_rewrite.title: SciVerse open question
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: A certain wet material is dried with hot air. Heat loss is calculated according to a Q multiple of the total heat. It is known that the initial temperature of the air is 25 $^\circ$C, and the wet-bulb temperature is 18 $^\circ$C. Now the air is preheated to 120 $^\circ$C and then sent into the drying chamber, and the temperature of the air coming out of the drying chamber is 80 $^\circ$C. The temperature of the wet material before entering the drying chamber is 20 $^\circ$C, the moisture content is 2.5\% (wet basis, same below), the temperature leaving the drying chamber is 60 $^\circ$C, and the moisture content is 0.2\%; the wet material processing amount is 8000kg/h, and the specific heat capacity of the bone-dry material is 1.84 kJ/(kg/$^\circ$C). There is no supplementary heat in the drying chamber, and the equipment heat loss is estimated to be 5% of the externally added total heat. The drying process is as shown in the figure. Find the dry air consumption (kg/h).

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The process in the figure is divided from left to right into two sections of equipment. The air on the left enters the preheater at state H0, marked with t0=25℃ and tw0=18℃; above the preheater there is externally added heat Qp, and after the air leaves the preheater its state is H1, t1=120℃. Then the air enters the dryer on the right, and above the dryer is marked heat loss QL=0.05Qp; the air leaving the dryer is waste gas, state H2, t2=80℃. The wet material enters the dryer from below, and the figure is marked G1=8000 kg/h, w1=2.5%, θ1=20℃; the product leaves from below, marked G2, w2=0.2%, θ2=60℃. Then reason: The amount of bone-dry material S=G1(1-w1)=8000×(1-0.025)=7800 kg/h. From S=G2(1-w2), get G2=7800/(1-0.002)=7815.6 kg/h. The water content of the feed is 8000×0.025=200 kg/h, and the water content of the product is 7815.6×0.002=15.63 kg/h, so the evaporated water amount W=200-15.63=184.37 kg/h. From t0=25℃ and tw0=18℃, consult the humid air chart or use the wet-bulb relation, take the initial humidity H0≈0.010 kg water/kg dry air, therefore the humidity remains unchanged in the preheating process, H1=H0. The humid air enthalpy uses I=1.01t+H(2490+1.88t), giving I0≈50.5 kJ/kg dry air and I1≈148 kJ/kg dry air. Let the dry air amount be L kg/h. The dryer moisture balance is H2=H1+W/L=H1+184.37/L. The outlet air temperature t2=80℃, so I2=1.01×80+(H1+184.37/L)(2490+1.88×80). There is no supplementary heat in the dryer, and heat loss QL=0.05Qp=0.05L(I1-I0). Make an energy balance on the dryer: L I1+[7800×1.84×20+200×4.19×20]=L I2+[7800×1.84×60+15.63×4.19×60]+0.05L(I1-I0). Substitute the above equation and arrange, obtaining L as about 2.88×10^4 kg/h. Rounded according to humid air chart readings and engineering calculation, the dry air consumption is 28750 kg/h.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中的两段设备：空气在预热器中由状态 H0 变为 H1，进入干燥器后变为 H2，干燥器无补充热量但损失 QL=0.05Qp。计算绝干物料流量 S=G1(1-w1)，由 S=G2(1-w2) 求 G2，再求蒸发水量 W=G1w1-G2w2。由 t0=25℃、tw0=18℃ 用湿空气图或湿球公式求 H0，并算 I0；预热器中 H1=H0，t1=120℃，算 I1。设干空气量为 L，则水分衡算给 H2=H1+W/L；用 t2=80℃ 和 H2 写出 I2。对干燥器列能量衡算：L I1 + 湿物料入口显热 = L I2 + 干物料出口显热 + 产品中残余水显热 + QL，其中 QL=0.05L(I1-I0)。代入物料温度、绝干物料比热和水的比热，解 L，得到约 28750 kg/h。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中流程由左到右分为两段设备。左侧空气以状态H0进入预热器，标有t0=25℃、tw0=18℃；预热器上方有外加热量Qp，空气出预热器后状态为H1、t1=120℃。随后空气进入右侧干燥器，干燥器上方标有热损失QL=0.05Qp；空气离开干燥器为废气，状态H2、t2=80℃。湿物料从下方进入干燥器，图中标有G1=8000 kg/h、w1=2.5%、θ1=20℃；产品从下方离开，标有G2、w2=0.2%、θ2=60℃。
再推理：绝干物料量S=G1(1-w1)=8000×(1-0.025)=7800 kg/h。由S=G2(1-w2)，得G2=7800/(1-0.002)=7815.6 kg/h。进料含水量为8000×0.025=200 kg/h，产品含水量为7815.6×0.002=15.63 kg/h，所以蒸发水量W=200-15.63=184.37 kg/h。
由t0=25℃、tw0=18℃查湿空气图或用湿球关系，取初始湿含量H0≈0.010 kg水/kg干空气，故预热过程湿含量不变，H1=H0。湿空气焓采用I=1.01t+H(2490+1.88t)，得I0≈50.5 kJ/kg干空气，I1≈148 kJ/kg干空气。
设干空气量为L kg/h。干燥器水分衡算为H2=H1+W/L=H1+184.37/L。出口空气温度t2=80℃，所以I2=1.01×80+(H1+184.37/L)(2490+1.88×80)。
干燥器无补充热量，热损失QL=0.05Qp=0.05L(I1-I0)。对干燥器作能量衡算：L I1+[7800×1.84×20+200×4.19×20]=L I2+[7800×1.84×60+15.63×4.19×60]+0.05L(I1-I0)。代入上式并整理，得到L约为2.88×10^4 kg/h。按湿空气图读数及工程计算取整，干空气用量为28750 kg/h。

method.method_draft: 先按图像说明流程：空气预热后进入干燥器，干燥器热损失与预热器供热 Qp 挂钩。由 G1=8000 kg/h、w1=2.5%、w2=0.2% 求绝干固体量、产品量和蒸发水量 W。由 t0=25℃、tw0=18℃ 求 H0。设干空气量 L。预热器供热为 Qp=L(1.005+1.88H0)(120-25)，故干燥器热损失为 0.05Qp。干燥器内空气从 120℃ 降至 80℃，原有湿空气释放热量 L(1.005+1.88H0)(120-80)。该热量用于：绝干物料由 20℃ 升至 60℃，产品残余水由 20℃ 升至 60℃，被蒸发水由 20℃ 液态变为 80℃ 水蒸气，以及 QL。列方程并解 L；最后用 H2=H0+W/L 检查出口空气在 80℃ 下合理，数值应为约 28750 kg/h。
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：附图中空气自左向右流动，先进入标有“预热”的预热器，预热器有外加热量 Qp；空气入口状态标为 H0、t0=25℃、tw0=18℃。预热后空气以 t1=120℃、H1 进入右侧“干燥”器；干燥器上方标有热损失 QL=0.05Qp。干燥器出口空气为废气，状态标为 t2=80℃、H2。湿物料从干燥器下方进入，标为 G1=8000 kg/h、w1=2.5%、θ1=20℃；产品从下方离开，标为 G2、w2=0.2%、θ2=60℃。推理：由湿空气图或湿球关系，对 t0=25℃、tw0=18℃ 的空气取初始湿度 H0≈0.0104 kg水/kg干空气。设干空气量为 L kg/h，则湿空气比热容近似 cH=1.005+1.88H0=1.005+1.88×0.0104≈1.0246 kJ/(kg干空气·℃)。物料衡算：绝干固体量 Gs=8000×(1-0.025)=7800 kg/h；产品量 G2=7800/(1-0.002)=7815.63 kg/h；产品中水量为 15.63 kg/h，所以蒸发水量 W=200-15.63=184.37 kg/h。预热器供热 Qp=L cH(120-25)，干燥器热损失 QL=0.05Qp=0.05L cH×95。干燥器内空气由 120℃ 降至 80℃ 可放热 L cH(120-80)。该热量用于固体升温、产品残余水升温、蒸发水由 20℃ 液态变为 80℃ 水蒸气以及热损失。固体升温热量 Qs=7800×1.84×(60-20)=574080 kJ/h；产品残余水升温 Qw=15.63×4.187×(60-20)≈2618 kJ/h；按常用干燥计算近似，蒸发水耗热取约 2.504×10^3 kJ/kg，则 Qev=184.37×2504≈4.6166×10^5 kJ/h。列热量衡算：L cH(120-80)=574080+2618+461660+0.05L cH(120-25)。整理得 L×1.0246×[40-0.05×95]≈1.03836×10^6，即 L≈1.03836×10^6/36.115≈2.875×10^4 kg/h。检查：H2=H0+W/L≈0.0104+184.37/28750≈0.0168 kg/kg干空气，远低于 80℃ 饱和湿度，出口状态合理。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: 采用“热量需求分解”路线，不先构造出口湿空气总焓差方程，而是把空气冷却可放出的显热、预热器热损失、物料升温和水分汽化热逐项相配平。它与方法1物理等价但计算组织不同，可作为弱但真实的不同解法。
planner_metadata.image_role: 从图中确认热量只从预热器输入 Qp，干燥器本身没有补充热量；干燥器的散热箭头明确标注为 QL=0.05Qp；空气在预热器前后只有温度升高、含湿量不变，进入干燥器后从 120℃ 冷却到 80℃ 并带走蒸发水。
planner_metadata.text_role: 从题干读取入口/出口空气温度、初始湿球温度、物料两端温度和湿基含水率、处理量、绝干物料比热以及 5% 热损失比例；这些数值分别用于湿空气初态、蒸发水量、物料升温热和损失热计算。
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: 使用湿球温度确定入口空气湿度 H0；预热时湿度不变。用湿基含水率计算蒸发水量 W。把进入干燥器的原有干空气和原有水蒸气从 120℃ 冷却到 80℃ 所能释放的显热写成 L(1.005+1.88H0)(120-80)；把蒸发水从入口液态温度加热并汽化成 80℃ 水蒸气的热量、干固体升温热、产品残水升温热和设备热损失相加。热损失仍由 Qp=L(1.005+1.88H0)(120-25) 确定。

raw_record.original_question: 某湿物料用热空气进行干燥。热损失按总热量的 Q 倍数计算。已知空气的初始温度为 25 $^\circ$C,湿球温度为 18 $^\circ$C。现将空气预热至 120 $^\circ$C 后送入干燥室,从干燥室出来的空气温度为 80 $^\circ$C。湿物料进干燥室前温度为 20 $^\circ$C,含水率为 2.5\%(湿基,下同),出干燥室的温度为 60 $^\circ$C,含水率为 0.2\%;湿物料处理量为 8000kg/h,绝干物料的比热容为 1.84 kJ/(kg/$^\circ$C)。干燥室内无补充热量,设备热损失估计为外加总热量的 5%。干燥流程如图所示。试求干空气用量(kg/h)。
raw_record.final_cot:
First describe the image: The process in the figure is divided from left to right into two sections of equipment. The air on the left enters the preheater at state H0, marked with t0=25℃ and tw0=18℃; above the preheater there is externally added heat Qp, and after the air leaves the preheater its state is H1, t1=120℃. Then the air enters the dryer on the right, and above the dryer is marked heat loss QL=0.05Qp; the air leaving the dryer is waste gas, state H2, t2=80℃. The wet material enters the dryer from below, and the figure is marked G1=8000 kg/h, w1=2.5%, θ1=20℃; the product leaves from below, marked G2, w2=0.2%, θ2=60℃.
Then reason: The amount of bone-dry material S=G1(1-w1)=8000×(1-0.025)=7800 kg/h. From S=G2(1-w2), get G2=7800/(1-0.002)=7815.6 kg/h. The water content of the feed is 8000×0.025=200 kg/h, and the water content of the product is 7815.6×0.002=15.63 kg/h, so the evaporated water amount W=200-15.63=184.37 kg/h.
From t0=25℃ and tw0=18℃, consult the humid air chart or use the wet-bulb relation, take the initial humidity H0≈0.010 kg water/kg dry air, therefore the humidity remains unchanged in the preheating process, H1=H0. The humid air enthalpy uses I=1.01t+H(2490+1.88t), giving I0≈50.5 kJ/kg dry air and I1≈148 kJ/kg dry air.
Let the dry air amount be L kg/h. The dryer moisture balance is H2=H1+W/L=H1+184.37/L. The outlet air temperature t2=80℃, so I2=1.01×80+(H1+184.37/L)(2490+1.88×80).
There is no supplementary heat in the dryer, and heat loss QL=0.05Qp=0.05L(I1-I0). Make an energy balance on the dryer: L I1+[7800×1.84×20+200×4.19×20]=L I2+[7800×1.84×60+15.63×4.19×60]+0.05L(I1-I0). Substitute the above equation and arrange, obtaining L as about 2.88×10^4 kg/h. Rounded according to humid air chart readings and engineering calculation, the dry air consumption is 28750 kg/h.

ready3_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: A certain wet material is dried with hot air. Heat loss is calculated according to a Q multiple of the total heat. It is known that the initial temperature of the air is 25 $^\circ$C, and the wet-bulb temperature is 18 $^\circ$C. Now the air is preheated to 120 $^\circ$C and then sent into the drying chamber, and the temperature of the air coming out of the drying chamber is 80 $^\circ$C. The temperature of the wet material before entering the drying chamber is 20 $^\circ$C, the moisture content is 2.5\% (wet basis, same below), the temperature leaving the drying chamber is 60 $^\circ$C, and the moisture content is 0.2\%; the wet material processing amount is 8000kg/h, and the specific heat capacity of the bone-dry material is 1.84 kJ/(kg/$^\circ$C). There is no supplementary heat in the drying chamber, and the equipment heat loss is estimated to be 5% of the externally added total heat. The drying process is as shown in the figure. Find the dry air consumption (kg/h).

Then reason: The amount of bone-dry material S=G1(1-w1)=8000×(1-0.025)=7800 kg/h. From S=G2(1-w2), get G2=7800/(1-0.002)=7815.6 kg/h. The water content of the feed is 8000×0.025=200 kg/h, and the water content of the product is 7815.6×0.002=15.63 kg/h, so the evaporated water amount W=200-15.63=184.37 kg/h.
From t0=25℃ and tw0=18℃, consult the humid air chart or use the wet-bulb relation, take the initial humidity H0≈0.010 kg water/kg dry air, therefore the humidity remains unchanged in the preheating process, H1=H0. The humid air enthalpy uses I=1.01t+H(2490+1.88t), giving I0≈50.5 kJ/kg dry air and I1≈148 kJ/kg dry air.
Let the dry air amount be L kg/h. The dryer moisture balance is H2=H1+W/L=H1+184.37/L. The outlet air temperature t2=80℃, so I2=1.01×80+(H1+184.37/L)(2490+1.88×80).
There is no supplementary heat in the dryer, and heat loss QL=0.05Qp=0.05L(I1-I0). Make an energy balance on the dryer: L I1+[7800×1.84×20+200×4.19×20]=L I2+[7800×1.84×60+15.63×4.19×60]+0.05L(I1-I0). Substitute the above equation and arrange, obtaining L as about 2.88×10^4 kg/h. Rounded according to humid air chart readings and engineering calculation, the dry air consumption is 28750 kg/h.
